# Sawyer & Co.

Sawyer & Co. is a sovereign institutional advisory and digital infrastructure firm operating across The Bahamas, Cayman Islands, Bermuda, Barbados, and Belize.

Core mandates:
- Regulatory & Compliance Advisory
- Institutional Capital & Structured Lending
- Digital Infrastructure & RegTech

Services include:
- AML/CFT compliance programmes
- MLRO governance
- FATF & DORA advisory
- Examination readiness
- KYC/CDD frameworks
- Institutional due diligence
- Private equity advisory
- Structured Lombard lending
- Digital asset compliance
- Treasury analytics
- Regulatory intelligence systems

Internal platforms:
- RegWatch
- TreasureCorp
- ZephyrWealth.ai

Founding Principals:
- Anwar Sawyer, LL.M.
- Sarah Sawyer

Website:
https://sawyer-co.vercel.app/
